title.en: Explorer and Cat in a Floating Eco-City
title.zh: 漂浮生态城中的探险者与猫

description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 gameplay prompt with attached video evidence from @AiMeowing.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3游戏画面提示词。

prompt: Ultra cinematic AAA adventure game trailer, one continuous seamless camera shot, Unreal Engine 5 quality, hyper realistic, 60 FPS, cinematic lighting, premium animation, realistic physics, smooth transitions, no text, no logo.  The camera begins behind a young silver-haired explorer and his fluffy orange cat standing together on a giant ancient tree branch overlooking a breathtaking futuristic nature city in the year 2100. Giant waterfalls flow through floating islands, enormous glowing trees surround eco-friendly futuristic towers, flying drones move naturally between the trees, distant floating platforms connect the landscape, soft volumetric sunlight fills the valley, leaves gently drift through the air, birds fly across the sky, mist slowly rolls through the forest.  Far away, a colossal ancient guardian peacefully walks through the valley between giant trees, partially hidden by fog, creating mystery and wonder.  The explorer and his cat quietly observe the distant guardian.  After two seconds, the explorer slowly raises his left hand.  He gently touches the glowing wrist device on his arm.  A soft circular pulse of blue light expands through the air.  Elegant transparent holographic interface panels smoothly appear around him with premium glass animation.  The interface feels futuristic, clean and luxurious.  Panels gracefully float into position using smooth spring motion.  Explorer Inventory.  Adventure Gear.  Explorer Suit.  Accessories.  Energy Tools.  Skills.  Artifacts.  Companion Gear.  Quest Journal.  Player Statistics.  Beautiful holographic cards slowly rotate in space.  Crystal accessories sparkle.  Energy gadgets softly glow.  Explorer suit pieces rotate in three dimensions.  Energy bow slowly turns with animated light effects.  The cursor appears naturally with smooth realistic movement.  It selects the glowing Energy Bow.  The selected card enlarges slightly.  The bow transforms into blue light particles and gracefully flies onto the explorer's back.  A quiver of glowing energy arrows materializes beside it.  Next the explorer suit activates.  Shoulder pieces.  Chest protection.  Explorer gloves.  Travel boots.  Utility belt.  Crystal rings.  Energy necklace.  Each item gently assembles onto the explorer with elegant magnetic energy effects.  Blue energy flows through every piece as it activates.  The cat watches curiously.  The cursor opens Companion Gear.  A lightweight explorer harness, glowing collar, utility backpack and protective accessories gently assemble onto the cat.  The cat happily stretches, shakes its body and looks proudly toward the valley.  The holographic interface slowly dissolves into glowing particles.  The environment becomes quiet again.  The explorer reaches for the glowing Energy Bow.  The cat lowers into an excited ready position.  They exchange a quick glance.  Without hesitation they begin running together across the giant tree branch.  The camera follows closely from behind with cinematic motion.  At the edge of the branch they leap together into the breathtaking futuristic valley.  The explorer's cape flows dramatically in the wind.  The cat glides gracefully beside him.  Leaves swirl around them.  Flying drones pass overhead.  The waterfalls rush below.  The camera follows their descent through the incredible landscape.  In the distance, the colossal guardian slowly turns its head after sensing their arrival.  The adventure has only just begun.  Fade to black.  Premium PlayStation first-party game trailer quality.  Natural facial animation.  Realistic cloth simulation.  Dynamic hair physics.  Cinematic camera movement.  AAA environmental storytelling.  Award-winning game cinematic.  Seamless single take.  No combat.  No violence.  Focus on exploration, discovery and adventure.
